about: The named read-only queries SQL Tools' Read-only query offers. Each is one SELECT; the engineer can edit it before it runs, and the read-only guard still applies.

queries.name: Version and edition
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name, SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion') AS version, SERVERPROPERTY('ProductLevel') AS level, SERVERPROPERTY('Edition') AS edition, SERVERPROPERTY('Collation') AS collation

queries.name: Databases
queries.sql: SELECT name, state_desc, recovery_model_desc, log_reuse_wait_desc, compatibility_level, collation_name, create_date FROM sys.databases ORDER BY name

queries.name: Database files
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS db, type_desc, name, physical_name, state_desc, size * 8 / 1024 AS size_mb FROM sys.master_files ORDER BY database_id, file_id

queries.name: Backup audit (this database)
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), b.backup_start_date, 120) AS taken, CASE b.type WHEN 'D' THEN CASE WHEN b.is_copy_only = 1 THEN 'Full (Copy-Only)' ELSE 'Full' END WHEN 'I' THEN 'Differential' WHEN 'L' THEN 'Transaction Log' WHEN 'F' THEN 'File / Filegroup' WHEN 'G' THEN 'Differential File' WHEN 'P' THEN 'Partial' WHEN 'Q' THEN 'Differential Partial' ELSE CONCAT('Unknown (', b.type, ')') END AS backup_type, b.database_name, b.backup_set_id, b.backup_set_uuid, b.name AS backup_name, b.description AS backup_description, b.is_copy_only, b.recovery_model, b.backup_start_date, b.backup_finish_date, DATEDIFF(SECOND, b.backup_start_date, b.backup_finish_date) AS duration_seconds, CAST(b.backup_size / 1048576.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS backup_size_mb, CAST(b.compressed_backup_size / 1048576.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS compressed_size_mb, CAST(100.0 * b.compressed_backup_size / NULLIF(b.backup_size, 0) AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS compressed_size_percent, CAST(b.backup_size / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(SECOND, b.backup_start_date, b.backup_finish_date), 0) / 1048576.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS throughput_mb_per_second, b.user_name AS backup_user, b.server_name, b.machine_name, CONCAT(b.software_major_version, '.', b.software_minor_version, '.', b.software_build_version) AS sql_server_version, b.software_vendor_id, ms.software_name AS backup_software, mf.family_sequence_number, CASE mf.device_type WHEN 2 THEN 'Disk' WHEN 5 THEN 'Tape' WHEN 7 THEN 'Virtual Device' WHEN 9 THEN 'Azure Storage' WHEN 105 THEN 'Permanent Backup Device' ELSE CONCAT('Other / Unknown (', COALESCE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), mf.device_type), 'NULL'), ')') END AS backup_device_type, mf.physical_device_name, b.has_backup_checksums, b.is_damaged, b.is_snapshot, b.begins_log_chain, b.has_incomplete_metadata, b.is_password_protected, b.key_algorithm AS encryption_algorithm, b.encryptor_type, CASE WHEN b.encryptor_thumbprint IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(40), b.encryptor_thumbprint, 2) END AS encryptor_thumbprint, b.first_lsn, b.last_lsn, b.checkpoint_lsn, b.database_backup_lsn, b.differential_base_lsn, b.first_recovery_fork_guid, b.last_recovery_fork_guid, restore_time.last_valid_restore_time, agent_job.job_name, agent_job.job_id, b.compatibility_level, b.expiration_date, b.position AS backup_set_position FROM msdb.dbo.backupset AS b CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS last_valid_restore_time) AS no_restore_time_column OUTER APPLY (SELECT last_valid_restore_time FROM msdb.dbo.backupset AS v WHERE v.backup_set_id = b.backup_set_id) AS restore_time LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupmediaset AS ms ON b.media_set_id = ms.media_set_id LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupmediafamily AS mf ON b.media_set_id = mf.media_set_id OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) sj.name AS job_name, sj.job_id FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory AS jh INNER JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs AS sj ON jh.job_id = sj.job_id CROSS APPLY (SELECT DATEADD(SECOND, jh.run_time / 10000 * 3600 + jh.run_time / 100 % 100 * 60 + jh.run_time % 100, TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(CHAR(8), jh.run_date), 112)) AS started) AS step_run WHERE jh.step_id > 0 AND jh.run_status = 1 AND b.backup_start_date >= step_run.started AND b.backup_start_date < DATEADD(SECOND, CASE WHEN jh.run_duration % 100 < 60 THEN jh.run_duration % 100 ELSE 0 END + 60 * (CASE WHEN (jh.run_duration / 100) % 100 < 60 THEN (jh.run_duration / 100) % 100 ELSE 0 END + 60 * (jh.run_duration / 10000)), step_run.started) ORDER BY jh.instance_id DESC) AS agent_job WHERE b.database_name = DB_NAME() ORDER BY b.backup_start_date DESC, b.backup_set_id DESC

queries.name: Backups in the last 7 days
queries.sql: SELECT bs.database_name, bs.type, bs.is_copy_only, bs.backup_start_date, bs.backup_finish_date, bs.user_name, bms.software_name, bmf.physical_device_name FROM msdb.dbo.backupset bs JOIN msdb.dbo.backupmediaset bms ON bms.media_set_id = bs.media_set_id LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.backupmediafamily bmf ON bmf.media_set_id = bs.media_set_id WHERE bs.backup_start_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, SYSDATETIME()) ORDER BY bs.backup_start_date DESC

queries.name: Log space
queries.sql: SELECT name, log_reuse_wait_desc, recovery_model_desc FROM sys.databases WHERE database_id > 4 ORDER BY name

queries.name: Sessions
queries.sql: SELECT session_id, login_name, host_name, program_name, status, login_time FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 ORDER BY login_time

queries.name: Logins
queries.sql: SELECT name, type_desc, is_disabled, default_database_name, create_date FROM sys.server_principals WHERE type IN ('S', 'U', 'G') ORDER BY name

queries.name: Availability group replicas
queries.sql: SELECT ag.name AS ag_name, ar.replica_server_name, ar.availability_mode_desc, ar.failover_mode_desc, ar.backup_priority FROM sys.availability_groups ag JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON ar.group_id = ag.group_id ORDER BY ag.name, ar.replica_server_name
